candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s. Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed fast. Payment dependency latency causes checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs not observed; latency localized to payment call by traces only.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s ReadTimeout on the order->payment authorization call in traces; inventory/redis succeed. Bounded candidate is downstream payment latency. Payment-side telemetry is missing to fully confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness
